identity: A scanned Palestinian primary-school science / values worksheet, OCR'd (initial ي is systematically rendered as dotless ى in ىنمو ىشرب ىعيش ىسمى ىغطي ىربيها ىقتلع ىحافظ ىعتني, and the coordinating و is spaced off as its own token). 184 tokens, 19 <NL>-delimited lines, exactly one exercise item per line, 20 items total. Three item types interleave: (a) true/false items closing with the fixed option pair صح / خطأ (items 1,2,3,6,7,11,12,15,20); (b) three-option multiple-choice items whose stem is a predicate frame closed by a copula هو / هي, a predicate verb ىسمى, a complete PP, or a stranded preposition في, followed by three asyndetic bare noun options (items 4,8,9,10,13,14,16,17); (c) values-education items closing with the fixed pair يعجبني / لا يعجبني (items 5,18,19). Content is unmistakably Palestinian curriculum: winter crops, wild vs. domesticated animals, overgrazing (الرعي الجائر), medicinal plants (يانسون، بابونج، قرنفل), the chukar partridge (الشنار), watermelon in the plains of Jenin, and Arafat's declaration of the State of Palestine. This is the same worksheet family as doc_00b450a96684 and doc_056d9b714661 — my two highest-scoring documents (F1 99.3 and 99.2) — down to the identical OCR spacing artifacts.
law: The unit is the LAYOUT SLOT, not the sentence. Every line is [stem] ‖ [option] ‖ [option] (‖ [option]). (1) The stem is ONE segment however long and whatever it contains: a coordinating و, a purpose clause, an iḍāfa, a title+name, a relative clause, and a stem-final copula (هو / هي), predicate verb (ىسمى) or stranded preposition (في) all stay inside it. (2) Each answer option is its own segment. (3) A multi-token option is never split internally — الرعي الجائر is one noun+adjective term, لا يعجبني is a negation bound to its verb. (4) Every token immediately before a <NL> is a boundary (all 19 taken), and the final token is a boundary. Nothing else in this document is a boundary: not the standalone و, not the relative التي / الذي, not a trailing لـ purpose clause.
reasoning: The register call decides almost everything, and it is unambiguous. Nineteen short <NL> lines, each closing either in a fixed binary option pair or in a triple of bare nouns with transparently silly distractors (البطريق 'penguin' among Palestinian birds; الفائز / الناجح offered as answers to 'what is letting animals eat the trees called'). That is a worksheet, so the unit is the layout slot and not the sentence, and the shape is stem ‖ option ‖ option ‖ option. My directly governing precedent is gold القمباز من التراث وترتديه النساء ‖ صح ‖ خطأ ‖ — same series, same صح/خطأ pair, same spaced-و OCR — and gold عبرت هبة الشارع و الإشارة الضوئية حمراء هذا السلوك ‖ غيرصحيح ‖ صحيح ‖, where my own earlier error was cutting inside the stem at the و. I applied that shape twenty times. || HARD SITE 1 — do the option triples split, or weld as lists? My standing law is that comma-lists and appositive runs WELD, and violating it once cost me twelve consecutive false cuts on a run of transliterated names. But that law is scoped to running prose; in quiz layout every gold I hold splits the options, across four documents scoring 93.5 to 99.3. This document settles it internally, which is better than precedent: its genuine enumerative list (علاج و طعام وشراب, item 3) and its genuine coordinated pair (اليانسون و البابونج, item 11) BOTH carry an explicit و and BOTH sit inside the stem ahead of صح/خطأ, whereas every option triple in the document is strictly asyndetic (القفازات الجوارب المظلة / قرنفل زعتر نعنع / الغزال الجمل الفيل / الشنار الكناري البطريق). So the discriminator is present in the ink: coordinated with و = list inside a stem, weld; asyndetic bare NPs following a predicate frame = option slots, split. I split them. || HARD SITE 2 — where does an MCQ stem end? At @70 ىسمى. The clause ترك الحيوانات تأكل الأشجار has no predicate at all unless ىسمى is inside the stem, and ىسمى occupies structurally the same slot as the gold-attested stem-final هو in ...علوم اللغة العربية هو ‖. The same argument places boundaries on هو @81 and هي @124 rather than one token earlier. || HARD SITE 3 — multi-token options. الرعي الجائر is a single fixed term ('overgrazing'); noun+adjective is NP-internal and splitting it would be exactly the apposition error my law forbids, so the boundary falls on الجائر @72 and not on الرعي @71. Note @72 is a boundary under both readings of that item (3-option or 4-option), so it is safe either way. Likewise لا يعجبني: the negation particle belongs to its verb, so the boundary lands on the SECOND يعجبني (@48, @162, @173) and never on لا (@47, @161, @172). || HARD SITE 4 — @115 في, my least certain call and the only stem in the document that ends on a function word. Either the stem is الحيوانات البرية تعيش في with three bare options الغابات / الشوارع / البيوت, or the stem is الحيوانات البرية تعيش with options في الغابات / الشوارع / البيوت. The second is not parallel, and printed MCQ options are parallel by construction; في occurs once and not three times, so it was printed inside the stem ahead of the blank. I cut at في and flag it med — this is precisely the off-by-one-token failure mode my law records as my persistent residual. || HARD SITE 5 — the multi-clause stems. Item 19, رامي ىحافظ على المزروعات و ىعتني بها, is a و plus a fresh finite verb sitting inside a stem, which is the single shape my record shows me falsely cutting in this exact register; it welds, boundary at بها @170. Item 18's trailing purpose clause ليستخدمها في التدفئة is a trailing subordinate and welds, boundary at التدفئة @159. Item 20's القائد ياسر عرفات is title+name (weld, per the السير precedent), and دولة فلسطين and سهول جنين are construct phrases (weld). || HARD SITE 6 — the من frame is ambiguous between the two item types and appears three times. In items 2 and 11 it is followed by a single noun and then صح/خطأ (من الثمار التي تنمو في فصل الشتاء البرتقال / من النباتات الطبية اليانسون و البابونج): that noun is the PREDICATE of the true/false proposition, part of the stem, and only صح and خطأ are options. In item 16 the same frame is followed by three nouns and no صح/خطأ (من الطيور الفلسطينية الشنار الكناري البطريق), so it is MCQ and the three split. The presence or absence of the صح/خطأ pair is what disambiguates, and it is visible on every line. || TALLY — 68 boundaries over 165 non-<NL> tokens: 20 stems averaging about 6 tokens, plus 48 one-to-two-word option slots. That sits inside the 3–10 token layout-driven range my law records for this register, all 19 pre-<NL> tokens are covered, and the final token is covered. My standing default is WELD at a coin-flip, and I have honoured it: every cut here names a layout slot, and I made no cut anywhere inside a stem.
